description: Allow-listed sandbox test suites for tests.run_sandbox. Agents pick a suite id, never a command. Every argv must start with {python} (the office's own interpreter). Runs in a subprocess with a scrubbed environment (no secrets, no tokens) and a timeout. It is not a network sandbox: containerized isolation is on the roadmap. Changing this file is a reviewed change.

office-governance.description: The Agent Office's own policy-engine and approval-desk tests.
